messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: Eval-gate [safety-checks] tripped for model-family:redwood-7b on production routes. Severity: P1. PagerDuty incident created: PD-43192. Check console: https://console.redwood.ai/evals/PD-43192
maya: acked on pager. looking now. anyone see customer errors?
sahil: saw uptick in flagged outputs in the last 10m, automated eval rejected ~12% of completions vs baseline 0.8%. link to eval dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/evals/summary?run=PD-43192
lisa: @sahil can you paste a couple of failing examples (sanitized) so we can confirm drift vs new false positives?
sahil: pasted some examples to the thread (sanitized). mostly truncated policy-violation-ish responses on payment-help prompts. weird pattern around list generation.
patrick: pulling deploy history — there was an automated model rollout 15m ago: redwood-7b:v2.3.4 -> v2.4.0 (canary->prod). code: `deployctl history --model redwood-7b --limit 5`
maya: ok that's our likely vector. rolling back canary to v2.3.4 for affected routes now. initiating route override.
oncall-bot: Command received: `route-override --route customer-chat --model redwood-7b:v2.3.4 --reason "eval gate trip PD-43192"`
patrick: rollback submitted, ETA ~45s. throttling new sessions until we confirm.
sahil: starting quick-run of our safety eval subset against v2.3.4 and v2.4.0 locally to compare. tiny script: ```python
# eval run snippet
from evals import run_suite
run_suite('safety-mini', model='redwood-7b:v2.4.0')
```
lisa: while tests run, @maya can you open a customer impact sweep? specifically: error-rate on API 429/500, complaint tickets, and any SLA hits in last 30m.
maya: started sweep. early look: no widespread 500s, a handful of customers reported odd replies (3 tickets in last 20m). tagging support leads.
patrick: results: v2.4.0 fails our safety-mini at 11.6% (matches canary eval), v2.3.4 fails at 0.7%. so regression confirmed. rolling full traffic back to v2.3.4 for impacted routes.
incident-bot: PagerDuty PD-43192 update: acked by maya. Escalation: on-call ML-SRE team paged.
sahil: created a temporary rule to disable automated rollouts for redwood-7b until postmortem: `featureflag.set("auto_rollout:redwood-7b", false)`
maya: applied traffic override, monitoring traces. latency and error metrics stable. customer tickets updated: initial triage notes added.
lisa: writing quick mitigation summary to customers on affected list, pinging support to hold. cc @patrick for technical notes.
patrick: next steps — 1) ensure rollback stays for 2 hours 2) run full eval suite on v2.4.0 to isolate failing tests 3) revert featureflag only after signoff 4) start postmortem draft. I'm assigning owners in infra board.
sahil: capturing failing prompts + model responses to a secure artifact for ML team: s3://secure-evals/PD-43192/ (redacted).
oncall-bot: Handoff reminder: maya is primary until 2093456830, then sahil will take over for watch window until closure.
maya: handing off to sahil now, leaving troubleshooting notes in the incident doc. I'm stepping offline for 20m.
sahil: taking lead. monitoring full suite run. if we still see >2% fail on representative traffic for 30m, we escalate to oncall-eng for hotfix.
lisa: I've started the postmortem outline in the incidents tracker: https://wiki.redwood.ai/incidents/PD-43192 — adding timeline and impact. please drop any logs or run commands there.
patrick: adding remediation: tighten eval-gate thresholds for canaries and add a temporary pre-deploy hook to block auto-rollouts on safety regressions. will open PR for pre-deploy check.
sahil: full-suite pass on v2.3.4 looks good. keeping traffic pinned. marking incident as mitigated in PD with note: rollback to v2.3.4; awaiting root cause analysis.
incident-bot: PD-43192 status: Mitigated. Please continue monitoring. Close when postmortem posted and owners assigned. :white_check_mark:
maya: thanks team. postmortem owners please sync and include ETA for safe auto-rollout re-enable.
patrick: assigned postmortem owner and ETA for PR review to Monday EOD.
sahil: locking down runbook updates for eval-gate -> will push a small doc change in 30m.
lisa: closing loop with support — customers notified about temporary behavior and rollback.
maya: resolved for now, keeping eyes on it for next hour then will close thread. :heart:
